actions.check: Attempt saves through forms and imports with absent, unknown, and valid passage IDs; only valid references should succeed.
actions.risk: A valid reference does not establish that the passage supports the wording.

actions.action: Export self-contained source-bound review snapshots
actions.mechanism: Bundling definitions with supplied passages preserves inspectability when a reader lacks access to the editing application.
actions.implementation: Generate a read-only HTML snapshot containing definition revisions, competing wording, disagreement notes, and passage-ID anchors with full supplied text.
actions.check: Open the snapshot offline; follow every definition’s source links and verify each exported dispute includes all competing wording.
actions.risk: Snapshots become stale; display their creation time and included revision IDs.

actions.action: Make disagreements explicit and inspectable
actions.mechanism: Dispute records connect competing definitions and explanations without selecting a winner or merging their wording.
actions.implementation: Attach disputes to definition IDs. Display a disagreement badge opening both wordings, their passage IDs, and editor-entered explanations.
actions.check: Create a dispute between two definitions; verify readers can inspect both sources and unchanged wordings from either definition.
actions.risk: An unexplained badge may imply more disagreement than documented.

actions.action: Distinguish scoped meanings from direct contradictions
actions.mechanism: Explicit applicability notes let different meanings coexist without automatically treating every wording difference as a conflict.
actions.implementation: Add optional scope notes with supplied passage IDs. Let editors classify relationships as overlapping, distinct-scope, or disputed while preserving both definitions.
actions.check: Create two scoped meanings and one disputed pair; verify classifications, wording, and supporting passages remain visible independently.
actions.risk: Unsupported scope labels can manufacture agreement; allow readers to inspect their evidence.

actions.action: Keep competing wording visible in search
actions.mechanism: Variant-aware retrieval prevents the default definition from hiding alternatives during term lookup.
actions.implementation: Index every retained definition’s wording. Group results by term, show disagreement counts, and expand matching variants with their passage IDs.
actions.check: Search a phrase appearing only in a competing definition; verify its term, wording, disagreement, and source are reachable.
actions.risk: Historical variants may clutter results unless clearly labeled.

actions.action: Export a self-contained review package
actions.mechanism: Bundling definitions, competing wording, disputes, and supplied passages preserves inspectability outside the editor without external dependencies.
actions.implementation: Generate a static review page containing all current variants, dispute explanations, and linked passage sections. Block export on unresolved passage references.
actions.check: Open the package offline; verify every definition reaches its exact passage and every recorded disagreement exposes all participating wordings.
actions.risk: Exported packages become stale after subsequent edits.

actions.action: Store competing definitions as separate sourced records
actions.mechanism: Separate term identity from definition wording so disagreement never requires overwriting another definition.
actions.implementation: Create term, passage, and definition tables. Require each definition’s passage ID to resolve within the supplied passage collection.
actions.check: Save two conflicting definitions for one term; verify both survive. Reject saves with missing or unknown passage IDs.
actions.risk: Editors may mistakenly create duplicate terms instead of variants.

actions.action: Flag definitions when supplied passages change
actions.mechanism: Immutable passage versions prevent source corrections from silently changing the evidence behind existing wording.
actions.implementation: Assign corrected passages new IDs linked to their predecessors. Keep definitions bound to original IDs and queue affected definitions for editor review.
actions.check: Replace a supplied passage; verify existing definitions still open the original and show a review flag until explicitly reviewed.
actions.risk: Frequent corrections can accumulate unresolved review work.

actions.action: Preserve wording through immutable definition revisions
actions.mechanism: Append revisions rather than overwriting text, retaining the exact wording and source bindings of earlier definitions.
actions.implementation: Store revision IDs, predecessor IDs, wording, and passage IDs. Make edits create new revisions; label older revisions without deleting them.
actions.check: Revise a disputed definition twice; verify all three texts and their original source links remain inspectable.
actions.risk: Revision history alone can conceal alternatives unless the interface exposes them.

actions.action: Represent disagreement as explicit competing definitions
actions.mechanism: Separate competing claims from revision history, preventing editorial preference from erasing a live alternative.
actions.implementation: Create dispute groups containing independently source-linked definition revisions. Record disagreement notes and editorial decisions separately; retain every competing text after resolution.
actions.check: Mark one wording preferred, then resolve the dispute; confirm readers can still inspect every alternative and its source.
actions.risk: A preferred label may appear authoritative; identify it as an editorial choice.

actions.action: Keep an append-only definition history
actions.mechanism: Versioned edits preserve earlier wording and its evidence instead of silently replacing a disputed definition.
actions.implementation: Write edits as new revisions carrying source passage IDs. Keep previous revisions readable; distinguish revising one definition from adding a competing definition.
actions.check: Revise a disputed definition twice; verify all wordings, source links, and the original dispute targets remain inspectable.
actions.risk: Revision history can become difficult to navigate.

actions.action: Keep competing definitions visible in search
actions.mechanism: Term-level result grouping prevents ranking or deduplication from silently suppressing less-preferred definitions.
actions.implementation: Index every retained wording. Group results by term, display alternative and dispute counts, and provide direct links to matching wording and passage IDs.
actions.check: Search a phrase unique to a nonpreferred definition; confirm that wording is reachable and its competing definitions are disclosed.
actions.risk: Large histories can overwhelm results; distinguish historical revisions from current alternatives.

actions.action: Show definitions, passages, and disagreements together
actions.mechanism: A contextual inspection view makes evidence and competing wording accessible without requiring readers to reconstruct their relationships.
actions.implementation: Add an inspect control beside each definition that opens its supplied passages, passage IDs, and competing definitions with clear labels.
actions.check: Using keyboard navigation, open a disputed entry and reach every competing wording and its complete linked passage.
actions.risk: Truncated excerpts can obscure qualifications; always provide access to the full passage.

agreement.caveat: Within-block descriptive agreement; candidate pairs are correlated, and agreement is not truth or human validation.

provenance.interpretation: Action-count and word-budget matched main arms, not token-matched; same-provider judges; no returned provider model snapshots.

globalBankMatchPolicy: Any nonnull match anywhere in a task/judge mechanism group makes that group non-new in every arm. Raw ratings remain unchanged.

successfulOnlySensitivity.criterion: Both contrasted main requests have success status; valid abstentions and failed acquisitions are excluded.

primary.decisionRule: Direction agrees, two-sided primary p ≤ .05, and the 95% interval excludes zero in that direction. No minimum practical benefit threshold.

analysis.secondaryMultiplicity: Holm across only the two specified secondary QNM contrasts; primary separate.
analysis.estimand: Equal-weight mean of paired task QNM@4 differences after averaging the two required judge configurations within each task and arm.

bankSizeSensitivity.reason: A single selected baseline_match ID cannot recover all matches against a restricted bank. Requires rejudging or complete annotations.

rng.algorithm: SHA-256(namespace + NUL + decimal block counter), 8 big-endian u32 values per block; rejection-sampled bootstrap indices; consecutive bits of u32 words form sign vectors.

analysis.publicationStatus: Development instrumentation check, excluded from main efficacy claims; inferential values are diagnostic only.
